LOGIC ADVENTURE 23 · CLASS 30

Bear’s Picnic Order

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Story sequencing

Basket, play, eat, wash — put Bear’s picnic day back in the right order.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · STORY SEQUENCING

Bear’s Picnic Order

Bear’s picnic is mixed up! Tap the pictures in story order: first, next, then, and last.

Tap the picnic story in order — first to last.

Picnic ordered!

Carry the basket, play on the blanket, eat a sandwich, wash the plate.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains story sequencing on the puzzle picture itself: the question is spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Prefer paper? The Bear’s Picnic Order worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
